text: Artificial intelligence is changing how we live, but it also raises important ethical questions. One major concern is bias—AI systems can learn from data that contains unfair prejudices, leading to decisions that treat people unequally. Fairness means making sure these systems do not discriminate against anyone based on race, gender, or background. Privacy is another key issue, as AI often collects huge amounts of personal information, so we need strong safeguards to protect it. Also, transparency is essential: people should understand how AI makes decisions, especially in areas like hiring or healthcare. Responsible AI development, therefore, requires careful testing, clear rules, and ongoing oversight to ensure technology serves everyone fairly and safely.
